frontmatter.name: recurring-task-author
frontmatter.description: Translate natural-language schedules ("every other Tuesday except school holidays") into RRule patterns and create the corresponding task occurrences.

findings.title: allowed-tools does not include the conditional MCP tasks.create path
findings.evidence: Phase 5 references 'if a `tasks.create` MCP path exists, call it' but allowed-tools is 'Read Write Edit' (SKILL.md:5).
findings.fix: Either add the qualified MCP tool name to allowed-tools, or reword Phase 5 to surface JSON for the user without conditional MCP invocation.

findings.title: Only one example present
findings.evidence: Single example covers WEEKLY+EXDATE only. MONTHLY/YEARLY branches untested.
findings.fix: Add a second example exercising MONTHLY (e.g. '1st Sunday of every month') or YEARLY+COUNT pattern.

findings.title: Edge Cases list does not cover BYSETPOS or anchor-in-the-past semantics
findings.evidence: Edge Cases enumerates 5 items but omits BYSETPOS compositions and what to do when DTSTART is in the past.
findings.fix: Add edge cases for 'last business day of month' (BYSETPOS=-1) and backfill-vs-skip behaviour for past anchors.

recommendation: Ship as-is. Highest-leverage polish is adding a second example covering a monthly or yearly pattern.
